# components/feature-grid

Import: `import { FeatureGrid } from "@tundralibs/ui/feature-grid"`

Shown on its demo page (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/components/feature-grid.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `FeatureGrid`

```ts
FeatureGrid(props: FeatureGridProps): Html
```

"Why us" in three columns: an icon chip, a short title, a sentence.
One column on a phone, two on a tablet, `columns` from a laptop up. A
linked item is clickable as a whole (its title link stretches over it),
so a card never carries a second "Learn more".

## Types

### `FeatureGridColumns`

Columns from 992px up (one below 576, two between).

- `"2"`
- `"3"`
- `"4"`

### `FeatureGridVariant`

Plain items on the page ground, or each in its own bordered card.

- `"plain"`
- `"cards"`

### `FeatureItem`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `Html` |  | An `Icon(...)`, drawn in a chip above the title. |
| `title` | `string | Html` | yes |  |
| `text` | `string | Html` | yes |  |
| `href` | `string` |  | Makes the whole item a link (stretched over the card). |

### `FeatureGridProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string | Html` |  | A heading over the grid. |
| `text` | `string | Html` |  | A line under the heading. |
| `items` | `FeatureItem[]` | yes |  |
| `columns` | `FeatureGridColumns` |  |  |
| `variant` | `FeatureGridVariant` |  |  |
| `align` | `"start" | "center"` |  | Text alignment inside each item (and of the heading). @default "start" |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### Three reasons, with icons

```ts
FeatureGrid({
  title: "Everything a month end needs",
  items: [
    { icon: Icon("send"), title: "Send in seconds", text: "Pick a customer, add the lines, send." },
    { icon: Icon("clock"), title: "Chases itself", text: "Reminders go out until it is paid." },
    { icon: Icon("shield"), title: "Bank-grade safety", text: "Payments run through a regulated provider." },
  ],
})
```

```html
<section class="feature-grid feature-grid--3">
  <div class="feature-grid__head">
    <h2 class="feature-grid__heading">Everything a month end needs</h2>
  </div>
  <div class="feature-grid__items">
    <div class="feature-grid__item">
      <span class="feature-grid__icon" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg width="20" height="20" width="2" …>…</svg>
      </span>
      <h3 class="feature-grid__title">Send in seconds</h3>
      <p class="feature-grid__text">Pick a customer, add the lines, send.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="feature-grid__item">
      <span class="feature-grid__icon" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg width="20" height="20" width="2" …>…</svg>
      </span>
      <h3 class="feature-grid__title">Chases itself</h3>
      <p class="feature-grid__text">Reminders go out until it is paid.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="feature-grid__item">
      <span class="feature-grid__icon" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg width="20" height="20" width="2" …>…</svg>
      </span>
      <h3 class="feature-grid__title">Bank-grade safety</h3>
      <p class="feature-grid__text">Payments run through a regulated provider.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

### Linked cards

A linked item is clickable as a whole; the title carries the link.

```ts
FeatureGrid({
  variant: "cards",
  columns: "2",
  items: [
    { title: "Docs", text: "Every endpoint, every field.", href: "/docs" },
    { title: "Changelog", text: "What shipped this week.", href: "/changelog" },
  ],
})
```

```html
<section class="feature-grid feature-grid--2 feature-grid--cards">
  <div class="feature-grid__items">
    <div class="feature-grid__item feature-grid__item--link">
      <h3 class="feature-grid__title">
        <a class="feature-grid__link" href="/docs">Docs</a>
      </h3>
      <p class="feature-grid__text">Every endpoint, every field.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="feature-grid__item feature-grid__item--link">
      <h3 class="feature-grid__title">
        <a class="feature-grid__link" href="/changelog">Changelog</a>
      </h3>
      <p class="feature-grid__text">What shipped this week.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
